name: What is the difference between a balcony and a deck, and which is right for my home?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a balcony and a deck, and which is right for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both balconies and decks extend living space outdoors, a balcony is typically elevated and cantilevered or supported by columns, often accessible from an upper floor of the home. A deck, conversely, can be ground-level or elevated, usually attached to the home's first floor or freestanding. The choice between a balcony and a deck depends on your home's architecture, desired access point, and intended use. AKN Design Group provides a single point of coordination to help you determine the optimal solution that enhances your home's functionality and aesthetic, integrating it with your overall residential design-build project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A balcony is an elevated extension from an upper floor, while a deck can be ground-level or elevated from the first floor. We help you choose based on your home and needs.
